source.description: Portable npm-format capture of the operator-approved corrected pi-subagents 0.77.0 installed package, whose stable-1.x Chord-omission guard (isStableV1/peersDeclareChord/canOmitChord in src/runs/background/runner-aliases.js) is absent from the clean published 0.77.0. Acquired from the operator's installed Pi agent package directory with 'npm pack --ignore-scripts' into a private temp destination, then copied unchanged to this test fixture. No source changes, rebuilds or patches were made. Test-only fixture for the hermetic Gate B owner; excluded from the production package payload. The public source repository's corrected guard is a different revision and is not this artifact; no source revision is claimed or verified for this capture.

notes: The clean published/locked 0.77.0 project-local copy of src/runs/background/runner-aliases.js is 3d97f6680e5741131fbf66eb4ab9516f7f54c669d387e8a3484c6d08fab2cea1 (old guard); it must not be substituted for this fixture. Whole-archive integrity is the sha256 above; module hashes are SHA-256 of the exact archive member bytes. This artifact is identity/provenance evidence only, not proof of native Gate B compatibility.
